Speech.NativeText: :-) Hey, it's so good to see you again!
:-) Hey, have you come to brighten up my day?
:-) Oh hi! Thanks to see you! {:-| I mean, I'm good to see you. It's good, thanks for asking. Oh, fuck.
:-) I sure have!
What? Not really, no.
:-) Sooo good to see you!
Right. Well, must be going.
:-) Aw, you too, buddy!
:-) Hey, I know exactly what you mean!
}:-| What? Spit it out.
:-( Uh, never mind.
{:-( Oh. Catch you later.
:-( Alright then, if you say so.
Look, uh.. I have a favour I need to ask you. It's about my ex.
Sure, anything!
Nope I'm not touching that.
:-( Oh... of course, I understand.
}:-| Some friend you are!
}:-| Oh... of course, I understand. I'm sure you've got your own problems to deal with, which are obviously much more important than my bullshit.
{:-( We never found %1 body. Everything went to shit when %2 died and I've never dared to go back for %3 and give %4 a proper burial. Will you help me?

%1 was a power-hungry %2. When I walked out, %3 said %4 would kill me for leaving, and I barely escaped with my life! I've lived in fear ever since... but I don't want to be afraid anymore. There's only one way this ends, it's %5 or me! Will you help me?

We left on really bad terms, and I just want to go back and see %1 one last time and say, you know, we can't ever get back together again but... I'm sorry. For the things I said. Do you think you could help me find %2?
{:-( I heard %1 was killed recently. We didn't leave on the best of terms, but it's water under the bridge now and... I'm so sad I'll never see %2 again. Will you help me go and pay my last respects?
{:-) Of course, I got your back!
{:-) %1! It's so good to see you, I've really missed you babe! We had something special, didn't we?
{:-| I was so sorry when you left, you know... {:-[ you really hurt me! But I've had time to think and... {:-) I think I could forgive you, if you really want to make it up to me. What do you say?
}:-| You know why I'm here.
}:-[ It's such a shame you couldn't be an adult about this.
How are you doing?
It's over.. I can't believe it's finally over.
{:-) Thank goodness I had you around to look after me... you're pretty badass you know!
{:-| So, here you are. I guess I got here too late for you to make good on your threat, huh. Well, maybe it's better this way. I don't have to hate you anymore.
I don't think I'm the person to do this.
{:-| Woah, %1! I... never thought I'd see you again, after you left. So, uh, how have you been?
{:-| I won't stay for long, %1. I just came to tell you that... I'm sorry, for what it's worth. I shouldn't have said what I said.
Oh. Okay, well, that's fine I guess. I don't know what you want me to say. But you do what you gotta do to feel better about yourself.
}:-| Okay this is your whole problem, you've always got to twist everything nice I try to do into something shitty!
}:-| Jesus, you were the one that wanted to come back here! Sorry I didn't react the way you had planned in your head, but it's not always about you.
}:-[ Aaargh forget it! I'm outta here.
{:-) Hey, it means a lot that you came here to say that. Thank you!
{:-) So long, old friend. I'll always treasure the time we had.
{:-) Me too!
Sure, run away! It's what you're best at, right?
How are you doing?
{:-( Goddammit that didn't help at all! Now I feel even more upset about this whole thing. Ugh. {:-) At least you're with me though.
I guess maybe I had to do this in order to figure out that it was a waste of time... :-) Thanks for being here for me through all this!
How are you doing?
{:-) That went well didn't it? Thank you so much for accompanying me! I'm glad it was you.
I feel I can finally turn the page on this relationship. And maybe look for a new one, who knows!
}:-) I found an easy mark for you! Get 'em, gang!
{:-( Oh no... %1, I'm so sorry I didn't come back to you sooner. Maybe I could have prevented this. It's all my fault.
How are you doing?
{:-( I can't believe this is how it ends! Poor %1, I should have been here for %2! I only hope %3 didn't suffer. Now I'll never be able tell %4 I'm sorry....
{:-) I'm glad I had you here to cuddle at least... :-) Thanks for being here for me through this!
{:-| %1, I'm so sorry I was too scared to do this earlier. You deserved better. I hope you're finally at peace now.
8-o %1, you're alive!
8-o %1! I thought you were dead!
{:-| I... I've joined %1 now. But you're right, I don't ever want to leave you again. %2, I'm sorry. I have to go and be with %3. We had some good times but... I hope you understand.
{:-) This is incredible! We have so much catching up to do!
{:-) Let's never get split up again!!
{:-) You're the best!

Quest.NativeDescription: Help %1 bury %2 ex and give a eulogy
